settings.description: ChromaHash rate-distortion ladder across byte budgets. Every point is the shipped v1 signal path with only the AC layout resized (L:C count ratio held at the shipped 26:9, L 5 b / chroma 4 b). Points at <=80 B use tier 0 (32 px raster); >=99 B use tier 1 (64 px raster) so the decoder's frequency filter never drops a selected coefficient. Incumbent is the shipped 32 B tier-0 default.
